title: Amber Action Type
description: Declarative description of a governed, evidence-backed operation an agent (or human) may submit against an Amber-governed repository. An Action Type turns a verb (start a session, verify evidence, approve a gate) into a type-constrained, auditable transaction with explicit parameters, submission criteria, effects, rollback behavior, and governance requirements. Design reference: operational-ontology positioning described in docs/wiki/amber-ontology-mcp.md.

actionTypeId.description: Unique, namespaced identifier for the action type, e.g. amber.session.start. First segment is always amber; further segments mirror the command family (session, route, context, governance).

version.description: Schema version of this action type definition. Bumping the version signals a breaking change in parameters, criteria, or governance.

title.description: Human-readable title for the action type.

goal.description: Single-sentence statement of what the action accomplishes, written as an outcome, not a procedure.

mode.description: Execution mode the action is allowed to run in. dry-run only validates and reports the intended effects without applying them. interactive requires a human confirmation step for execution. autonomous permits governed execution without a human round-trip.

parameters.description: Named input parameters the action accepts. Keys must be lowerCamelCase identifiers.

type.description: JSON type of the parameter value.

required.description: Whether the parameter must be provided when the action is submitted.

description.description: What the parameter means and how it is used.

default.description: Default value applied when the parameter is omitted. Type must match the declared type.

enum.description: Closed set of allowed values, when the parameter is constrained.

pattern.description: ECMA-262 regular expression that string values must satisfy.

submissionCriteria.description: Preconditions that must hold for the action to be accepted (e.g. 'session status is created', 'evidence hash is present'). Mirrors the governed-runner gate checks.

edits.description: Repository artifacts the action may mutate (e.g. '.amber/sessions/<id>/manifest.json', 'docs/wiki/index.md').

sideEffects.description: Out-of-band consequences fired on successful execution. Ledger and timeline records are always written; listing them here documents the intent.

rollback.description: Whether the action supports reversal (e.g. session abort, ledger tombstone).

evidenceRequired.description: Evidence kinds the mapped command actually records before the action is considered complete (e.g. 'timeline-event', 'approval-record'). Registration rejects missing or invented evidence kinds.

timeout.description: Maximum execution time in seconds before the action is aborted and marked incomplete.

policy.description: Reference to the governance policy that authorizes this action (e.g. 'governance/policy.md#session-lifecycle').

approver.description: Parties that may approve execution. human requires a person; loop-contract allows an approved autonomous loop; system allows internal programmatic approval.

evidence.description: Evidence kinds declared by the governance contract. For the current MCP Action registry this must agree exactly with the mapped command's persisted evidence; registration rejects drift.

circuitBreaker.description: Whether a failure or anomaly in a previous action pauses the family until inspected.

worktreeIsolation.description: Whether execution must happen in an isolated worktree rather than the working branch.

variantParam.description: Parameter name whose value selects the execution variant (e.g. objectType).

variants.description: Map from variant value to a command/subcommand/args mapping.

variantParam.description: Parameter name whose value selects the execution variant (e.g. objectType). Present only when the action dispatches to different commands per parameter value.

variants.description: Map from variant value to a command/subcommand/args mapping. Present only when variantParam is present.

command.description: Amber CLI command family this action maps to.

subcommand.description: Amber CLI subcommand within the command family.

args.description: Ordered argument templates that build the CLI invocation from the submitted parameters. Each template binds one flag or positional slot to a parameter source or a literal value.

flag.description: Flag form, e.g. --goal. Mutually exclusive with position.

position.description: Positional slot, e.g. the route id in `route test <id>`. Mutually exclusive with flag.

source.description: Dotted path into the submitted parameters, e.g. parameters.goal. Mutually exclusive with value.

value.description: Literal value injected as-is. Mutually exclusive with source.

optional.description: When true, a missing source parameter is skipped instead of failing the call.

flagOnly.description: When true, emit only the flag without a value (boolean flags such as --json). Mutually exclusive with source/value.

name.description: Function identifier exposed to agents, e.g. 'resolveEvidenceHash'.

language.description: Runtime language of the function implementation.

entryPoint.description: Repository-relative path to the function implementation.

functions.description: Deterministic helpers the action may call (hash resolution, ledger queries). Functions do not widen the action's governance scope.
